data.title: Living history in July – two events in northern Slovakia
data.excerpt: The second weekend in July will be a feast for everyone who likes the history of antiquity, the Slavs and the Early Middle Ages. Two events of a very high international standard will be held in parallel in northern Slovakia: Živý starovek at Liptovská Mara – Havránok, and Utgard, a festival of the early Middle Ages, at Jasenové.

mediaTexts.alt: A poster for the Živý starovek event at Havránok with warriors in period armament

children.text: The second weekend in July will be a feast for everyone who likes the history of antiquity, the Slavs and the Early Middle Ages. Two excellent events of a very high international standard will be held in parallel in northern Slovakia, and they are definitely worth going to.
After an unwanted year’s break, the event called Živý starovek will again be held

. It is organised by the civic association Vae Victis from Lietavská Lúčka, and the standard of this event grows from year to year. On 11. 7. 2015 you can look forward to Celts, Romans, Germanic peoples and, for the first time, Macedonian hoplites as well. As in previous years, the participation of groups not only from Slovakia but also from other countries is expected.
The organisers say the following about the event on their website:
At the moment 80 people have signed up with us, but only half of them may come

That is why we do not want to promise, say, a mass battle and then find out that there are few of us and the visitors will be disappointed .... but we certainly always try to fill the programme so that almost every visitor is satisfied. I write almost because there is always someone who cannot be accommodated. For better orientation the programme will be written out and made visible right on the spot, so that visitors can decide what interests them and when, on the contrary, they would rather spend the time elsewhere. For example by the water at the reservoir

But what is never missing at our event is, 
 1). An opening presentation of the participants, ending with a joint procession into the sanctuary and an offering to the gods
 2). Presentations of crafts and products, combined with the chance to try everything with your own hands
 3). A tasting of ancient cuisine
 4). A presentation of the individual cultures, the different equipment of armament and fighting techniques, the different fashion and cuisine. Connected with this are also talks given in an easy-going humorous form, so that visitors take away with them not only experiences but also some new insights. 
 5). A display of combat, a mass battle or single combat between individuals (we will specify)
 6). A closing ritual, traditionally combined with the ritual sacrifice of a human being to the old deities.

The programme is structured so that there is time for refreshments as well and visitors still do not miss anything. 
 We look forward to seeing you and thank you for your favour and support
Brendyx "druid" of the Vae Victis tribe
The second event, which will be held in the village of Jasenové (Žilina Region) on 11.7.2015, is Utgard - a festival of the early Middle Ages.

The organisers write about the festival:
 
 On Saturday 11.7.2015 the first early medieval festival of Vikings and Slavs in Slovakia will take place, with the participation of almost 100 warriors from Slovakia, Bohemia and Poland. A historical camp, period cuisine, period crafts, archery, a group tournament for the bridge, a great battle of Vikings and Slavs.
 
 
 
 Venue: Jasenové
 Žilina Region
 GPS: 49.114299, 18.639264 
 
 Programme of the day / Program dnia
 
 Saturday 11.7.2015 
 
 10:00 Opening / Otwarcie 
 11:00 A talk on the life of the Slavs / Wykład na temat życia Słowian 
 12:00 Hólmgang (single combats) / Turniej bojowy (1 na 1) 
 14:00 Group combats for the bridge / Turniej grupowy o most 
 17:00 A great battle of Vikings and Slavs / Wielka bitwa Wikingów i Słowian.
 
 Sunday / Niedziela 12.7.2015 
 
 12:00 A great battle of Vikings and Slavs / Wielka bitwa Wikingów i Słowian.
 
 Groups / Drużyny: 
 
 Gunnar, Kmenový svaz Styrke, Marobud, Herjan, Siváci, Nuntius Regis, Drengowie Znad Górnej Odry, Velkomoravané, Daga, Slavibor, Dagstyrr, Njörd, Drużyna Najemna Rujewit, Drużyna Wiciedzy Jarowita, Wojowie Siemomysla, Drużyna Woje Peruna, Aurinko Félag, Bielska Drużyna Najemna "Svantevit" ...
 
 NOTE: The Saturday programme is intended for the general public only within the set time from 10:00 to 18:30, that is to say during the programme. Admission is free. 
 
 After the programme ends, the historical camp will be closed to the public. Visitors will, however, be able to carry on enjoying themselves in the adjacent village of Jasenové, where at 19:00 a cultural programme will begin as part of the gourmet goulash-cooking competition, JASENOVSKÁ VAREŠKA.
